mappings.note: flight-speed model where 30 minutes must become 1/2 hour before x^2 - 200x - 240000 = 0 appears; the negative speed is inadmissible
the mirror case of the slowed flight -- speed INCREASED to recover lost time -- giving x^2 + 100x - 300000 = 0; same pair of outcomes, opposite sign structure
outward and return journeys over the same 150 km with a 2.5 hour difference; translation to x^2 + 10x - 600 = 0 then factorisation, negative speed rejected
two DIFFERENT distances at two speeds summing to a fixed total time, so the times add rather than subtract; a distinct translation from the same-distance items, then splitting
duplicate of the 360 km / 48 minute train item earlier in the chapter; the same x^2 + 5x - 2250 = 0 and the same rejection of a negative speed
upstream minus downstream time equals 1 hour, which unlike the 4.5-hour boat item leaves an x term and so a genuine quadratic x^2 + 48x - 324 = 0 to factorise
the graded work is turning an unchanged-total-cost condition into a quadratic in the length; the key is cut off before naming a solving method, so no solving outcome is claimed
needs the angle-in-a-semicircle fact before Pythagoras yields x^2 + 7x - 120 = 0, which the key solves by the formula; a geometry-flavoured translation
an age product across two time shifts giving x^2 + 5x - 66 = 0; a negative age is inadmissible so only x = 6 survives

the area difference factorises as pi(r2-r1)(r2+r1), so the problem resolves into two LINEAR equations and no quadratic is ever solved; only the translation outcome honestly applies -- flagged as a poor fit
perimeter and area of a rectangle give x^2 - 41x + 400 = 0, and BOTH roots are admissible -- they simply name the two sides, unlike the reject-one-root items
the area condition gives 3x^2 - x - 24 = 0 and then a further Pythagoras step for the hypotenuse; the negative x is rejected as a length
two verbal comparisons pin the hypotenuse and base in terms of the altitude, and Pythagoras collapses to x(x-8) = 0; the root x = 0 is rejected as a degenerate triangle
solved by the identity (a+b)^2 = a^2+b^2+2ab to get ab directly, so no quadratic equation is formed or solved; the translation is all that is genuinely assessed -- flagged as a poor fit
diagonal and longer side both expressed against the shorter side, and Pythagoras gives x^2 - 4x - 60 = 0; the negative length is inadmissible
externally touching circles make the centre distances x+9 and x+2, and the stem explicitly asks to WRITE the equation and then solve it; both halves of LO-6 plus factorisation
a uniform border problem where the pond dimensions are 50-2x by 40-2x; one root of x^2 - 45x + 296 = 0 is geometrically impossible because it exceeds half the width

the one item that walks all three steps explicitly: frame the equation from the tiling situation, solve it BY FACTORISATION, then solve it AGAIN by the quadratic formula; all three outcomes are separately instructed

a profit FUNCTION is supplied, so nothing is translated from scratch; the break-even part asks for the zeroes of that polynomial (C-2.1-LO-5) and finds them by factorisation, while the other parts are evaluations

evaluates a height function at two times and explains why they agree by the axis of symmetry; symmetry and the vertex of a quadratic have no learning outcome in this frame, so the goal code carries that half (gap reported)
the x-intercepts are the zeroes of the profit polynomial (C-2.1-LO-5), but parts (iii)-(iv) ask for the MAXIMUM, which no outcome covers; the printed model is also doubly corrupted (defect reported)

the ground-strike condition h(t) = 0 is factorised to give t = 0 and t = 11, and part (iii) asks what the TWO roots mean physically -- the admissibility/interpretation clause of LO-6 meeting the roots-as-zeroes idea
builds an area function from a fencing constraint and then MAXIMISES it by completing the square; the modelling is LO-6 but the optimisation has no outcome, so CG-2 is the honest second code
the same optimisation shape with internal partitions changing the constraint to 4x + 2L = 384; the harder step is the constraint, not the maximisation, but both codes are still needed
a common increase applied to both dimensions gives x^2 + 18x - 144 = 0, which the key solves by the formula; a negative increase is rejected
